pages.title: Spice Maps
pages.text: Maps leading to certain $(l:exploration/spice_regions)spice regions$() can be found throughout the world, in places where plunderers hide out and shinies are hidden.

pages.title: Spice Maps
pages.text: These spice maps may also be bought from villagers specializing in cartography. Higher levels will yield higher $(l:basics/what_is_a_spice)tiers of spices.$()
